title: pleroma citrinum
intro: Pleroma citrinum, commonly known as the "Sour Plum", is a plant species used in traditional medicine, particularly in China. It has been used to support health by providing several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as aiding in the regulation of blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Pleroma citrinum include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable component in herbal remedies.
